parts.t: Neighbourhood guide · City of Chilliwack · Little Mountain
Little Mountain is an MLS® sub-area name in the City of Chilliwack. The City doesn’t publish a boundary for it.
The closest official description is the City’s population page, which lists Little Mountain among its Central neighbourhoods and gives a 2021 population of 1,170.
Little Mountain Elementary is at 9900 Carleton Street.

blocks.text: Planning and flood notes for Little Mountain

parts.t: Plans, zoning and flood rules can be different for each lot.
The City’s Neighbourhoods page lists no Little Mountain neighbourhood plan, so the City-wide Official Community Plan applies.
Official Community Plan Bylaw 2025, No. 5500 (Chilliwack 2050) was adopted on December 16, 2025.

ALR: Published municipal records list no ALR land in Little Mountain in published municipal planning documents. City-wide, 67% of Chilliwack’s land (17,322 hectares) is in the Agricultural Land Reserve.

Flood and slope: Published municipal records list no City flood, slope or ravine page specific to Little Mountain. For floodplain land, the City’s Floodplain Regulation Bylaw 4519 sets the Flood Construction Level plus 0.6 m of freeboard for construction in areas protected by a standard dike.
My
Chilliwack zoning guide
covers agricultural and rural zones only. For a home on a city lot, send me the address and I’ll look up the zone.

blocks.text: Before you buy in Little Mountain

parts.t: Ask about slope and drainage.
For hillside lots on Little Mountain, check DPA-2 requirements with the City and have the inspector check drainage and the ground around the home.
Check the flood rules for the lot.
Ask the City whether the floodplain bylaw applies to the exact address.
Confirm the school catchment.
Use the SD33 School Locator for the exact address, since catchments are changing in 2027.
For a strata home, read the documents.
The depreciation report, meeting minutes, bylaws and fees, plus any special levies.
Get a full home inspection.
Check the roof, drainage, furnace, plumbing and wiring.
Where is Little Mountain?
Little Mountain is an MLS® sub-area name. The City doesn’t publish a boundary for it.
The City’s population page lists Little Mountain among its Central neighbourhoods and gives a 2021 population of 1,170.
Ask me if a specific address is in it.
Which school is in Little Mountain?
Little Mountain Elementary (kindergarten to grade 5) is at 9900 Carleton St.
SD33 approved changes, effective September 2027, that split the Cheam Elementary catchment between Little Mountain Elementary, Strathcona Elementary and a new east side elementary school.
Check an exact address with the
SD33 School Locator
What trails and recreation are near Little Mountain?
The City’s Parks and Trails directory lists Little Mountain Trails and Little Mountain Stairs.
No City recreation centre is in the Little Mountain area. The nearest is Chilliwack Landing Leisure Centre at 9145 Corbould St.
The nearest library is the Chilliwack Library at 45860 First Avenue.
How do I get around from Little Mountain?
No route in BC Transit’s Chilliwack route list is named for Little Mountain.
Route 53 Fairfield has a timing point at Young Rd at Clare Ave, and route 51 Vedder has one at Yale Rd at Menzies St.
See the
BC Transit Chilliwack page
What plan covers Little Mountain?
The City’s Neighbourhoods page lists no Little Mountain neighbourhood plan, so the City-wide Official Community Plan applies. The current plan is Official Community Plan Bylaw 2025, No. 5500.
Is Little Mountain in the ALR, and what are the lots like?
ALR status is set parcel by parcel, so check the exact address on the
Agricultural Land Commission map
. Published municipal records list no ALR land in Little Mountain in published municipal planning documents.
Lot size (FVREB MLS® recorded sales data): the median lot size of detached houses sold in recent 2026 MLS® activity was 10,454 sq ft, based on 7 sales with a recorded lot size.
That is only 7 sales.
